sections.title: General Info
body: Tres y Dos is a fast-paced matching card game.
The goal is to form one set of 3 matching cards and one set of 2 matching cards.
The first player to complete a valid hand and claim it wins the round.

sections.title: Cards
body: The game uses a standard deck of cards.
Cards match by rank only, not suit.
For example, any three 7s make a valid set of 3, regardless of suit.

sections.title: Game Rules
body: Players draw and discard cards during their turn.
The objective is to collect matching ranks.
A winning hand must contain one set of 3 matching cards and one set of 2 matching cards.
The set of 3 and the set of 2 must be different ranks.
Example: 7♠ + 7♥ + 7♦ and K♣ + K♠ is a valid hand.

sections.title: Claiming a Win
body: As soon as a player forms a valid Tres y Dos hand, they can claim the round.
Only the first player to claim a valid hand wins.
If multiple players have a valid hand, the fastest claim takes priority.

sections.title: Strategy Tips
body: Watch what cards other players discard.
Keep flexible combinations while building your sets.
Avoid revealing what rank you are collecting.
